cards.prompt: The chart shows the number of library visitors from January to June. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features. Write at least 150 words.
cards.sample: The bar chart illustrates how many people visited a library each month in the first half of the year. Overall, visitor numbers rose considerably, despite a small dip in April...
